bifrost: springboard/src/bare/input.rs (evdev decoding, pointer and touch only); springboard/src/bare/vibrator.rs (device vibrator check for Keyboard Haptics); springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Bluetooth adapter, not a game controller profile); no app-facing SDK module for controllers
summary: BifrOSt has no game controller API. Its evdev layer decodes touch, pointer, keyboard and key events and nothing else, so an app cannot discover a gamepad, read its buttons or sticks, or drive its haptics. The framework's keyboard and mouse profiles map loosely to the input layer that exists, but no app receives them through an SDK API.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/chord_recovery.rs (inotify on /dev/input for hot-plug, used by the recovery chord only)
features.note: The kernel-level hot-plug watch exists, but it only serves the recovery chord. No controller list or connect event reaches apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/input.rs (ABS_X/ABS_Y, BTN_TOUCH, BTN_LEFT, key codes); springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (app control socket, not input)
features.note: Decoding handles pointer, touch and keyboard only. No gamepad axes, buttons, triggers or hats are mapped, and no SDK type exposes input state.

features.feature: Button, axis, switch and direction-pad elements
features.bifrost: none; springboard/src/bare/input.rs has no element model
features.note: No element abstraction exists. Standard gamepad element names (BTN_SOUTH, ABS_HAT0X and similar) are not used anywhere in the repo.

features.feature: Keyboard and mouse as game input
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/hwkeys.rs (hardware-keyboard shortcuts); springboard/src/shell/evkeys.rs (evdev key to character); springboard/src/bare/input.rs (pointer decoding)
features.note: The shell reads keyboards and mice itself for its own shortcuts. Apps get no GCKeyboard or GCMouse style profile in the SDK.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/vibrator.rs (vibrator_available() checks for a device node, used for Keyboard Haptics)
features.note: The vibrator check serves the keyboard feedback setting only. No rumble or haptic-locality API exists for controllers or apps.
No controller battery or light query. springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs is the Bluetooth adapter and would be the transport for a wireless pad, but it does not read pad profiles.
No motion or orientation input is read from controllers or from the device.
The touch layer could feed a virtual pad, but no SDK virtual controller exists.

features.feature: Racing wheels, paddles and gear shifters
features.note: No force-feedback or wheel input model exists.

features.apple: Not part of Game Controller (web Gamepad API)
features.note: The browser engine is compiled with Servo's gamepad feature. Whether that feature receives evdev controller events is not verified in this pass, so this row is not confirmed for web pages.

gaps: No controller discovery or connection events for apps (GCController.controllers, controllerDidConnect).
No gamepad input model: no buttons, axes, triggers, hats or direction-pad elements in the evdev decoder (springboard/src/bare/input.rs).
No SDK input profile for apps (extended, micro or racing wheel profiles).
No haptics or rumble API for controllers (springboard/src/bare/vibrator.rs only checks for a vibrator node).
No controller battery, light or motion data.
No virtual controller for touch-only devices.
No Home button or controller settings manager (GCControllerHomeButtonSettingsManager) and no controller pages in Settings (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs has no controller page).
Web Gamepad API status unverified (springboard/apps/browser/engine/Cargo.toml enables Servo's gamepad feature).
